raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (378 rows, source_tz='UTC') carries UTC timestamps, while every other batch is in America/Chicago local time (opening hours start about 06:00 local). The UTC rows were read as local time, so evening Chicago transactions landed on 2026-01-19 at 00:00-04:56 and the 2026-01-18 and 2026-01-19 dates are wrong. Converting source_tz='UTC' rows to Chicago time (UTC-6, since all data is in January/CST) puts them back on the right local day and within opening hours.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
